verdict: Google Business activity dropped sharply this week; organic traffic holding but softening.
narrative: This period, your leads are coming entirely through organic channels — no paid advertising is running on Meta or Google. Your Google Business Profile drove 50 actions over the last 28 days, including 30 direction requests and 1 call, but activity came to a near-complete stop in the last three days of the week (Aug 18–20), down 89% from the prior week. Website traffic also eased, with sessions down about 21% week-over-week. Separately, your website received 184 sessions this period but recorded zero tracked conversions, meaning incoming visitors are not being captured as leads — we're repairing the conversion tracking now so that number accurately reflects what's happening. Expect a clearer lead count once tracking is restored, and we're investigating the Google Business Profile drop to restore normal visibility this week.
